about.run: robot demo by hand clock, 180 ticks, a sample every 6th tick
about.playRect: canvas minus the top HUD bars (.play-hud-progress, .play-hud-corner, .play-hud-goal) and the bottom row, zone labels and buttons
about.fill: median vertical extent of the spread (hero + live targets and hazards in front of the camera) clipped to playRect, share of its height
about.cropped: share of frames with any body centre off the canvas sideways
about.underHud: share of frames where the hero or nearest target box intersects a top HUD bar or a bottom control
about.heroShare: median canvas area share of the hero box (p61-portrait)
about.foeSeen: share of frames with the nearest target centre on the canvas (p61-portrait)
about.thumbZone: control centre in the bottom 45 % of the height
